title: In-page navigation
summary: link address starts with #, the browser uses the text after # to find the id with the same name and locates the corresponding element.
tasks: Add id="lab" to the section introduced in the training room.
Add a to nav, the link text is "View training room", and the href points to #lab.
hint: When clicking does not jump to the introduction area, check whether the href of the link is written as #lab, and whether the id of the target area is only written as lab.
goal: allows readers to click on the navigation link to locate the training room introduction on this page.
